annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission; as retained and amended in UK law (legislation.gov.uk, King's Printer)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets design and manufacture requirements for UAS classes UK0 to UK6 for the 'open' category, including mass limits, geo-awareness, remote identification, and noise limits.
Obliges manufacturers, importers and distributors to carry out conformity assessment, draw up declarations of conformity and affix UK marking and class labels.
Establishes approved conformity assessment bodies, accredited by UKAS, and market surveillance authorities.
Requires certification of UAS that carry people or dangerous goods, or are large and operated over assemblies of people.
Applies UK rules to third-country UAS operators; amended in 2025, with effect from 1 Jan 2026.
annotation.summary_en: UK-retained version of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems, as amended through 2025 (effective 1 Jan 2026). It sets product requirements for UAS classes UK0 to UK6, economic operator duties, conformity assessment, approved bodies, market surveillance, certification triggers and third-country operator rules.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 of 12 March 2019 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 of 12 March 2019 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
